messages:
Maris (Product Design): quick UX review on Compliance > Data retention / Encryption section. screenshot attached. two quick things: 1) label for retention looks fuzzy — 'Retention' vs 'Retention period' vs 'Data retention TTL' ? 2) region selector shows 'Europe (eu-west-1)' — should we surface a friendly region name + code or keep full code? also KMS label currently reads 'KMS key' — legal asked for 'Customer-managed key (CMK)' in some places. proposed copy block below, thoughts? :thinking:

``
Retention label: "Retention period"
Retention helper: "How long we will retain user and request metadata. Default: 30 days."
Region dropdown item: "Europe — eu-west-1"
KMS field label: "Customer-managed key (CMK)"
Audit link: "View audit logs"
```

Jamal (Frontend): I like 'Retention period' — shorter than 'Data retention period' and reads fine. UI width is tight in the table so avoid extra words. For region, 'Europe — eu-west-1' is fine, use an icon for region badge rather than long names. KMS: 'Customer-managed key (CMK)' ok but be careful with tooltip overflow.

Priya (A11y): +1 on 'Retention period'. Please add descriptive text for screen readers. Suggest aria-label on the duration input: `aria-label=\"Retention period in months\"` and on the region dropdown `aria-label=\"Deployment region\"`. Also ensure the KMS field has `aria-describedby` pointing to helper text with the expansion control.

Nikhil (PM): We should also standardize across Console: other pages use 'View audit logs' not 'View logs' — prefer explicit 'audit' for legal/audit teams. Also retention default copy should include a short example: 'e.g., 30 days, 12 months'.

Elsa (Legal): Confirming preference for 'Customer-managed key (CMK)' in UI when a customer supplies their own key. But in places where we mention managed keys generically, we can keep 'KMS key'. Also add a hover tooltip: 'CMK: Customer-managed key stored in your KMS'.

Owen (Security): FYI if we change to 'Customer-managed key (CMK)' let's append a short permission note: 'Requires KMS:Encrypt permission'. Could be in helper text. Also think about exposing key fingerprints in the details view (separate epics).

Maris (Product Design): thanks all — actionable: switch label to 'Retention period', update helper copy to include examples, region render as 'RegionName — region-code' with small badge, change audit link to 'View audit logs', and KMS wording to 'Customer-managed key (CMK)' with tooltip. Priya, will you paste the exact aria attributes you want and I'll wire them to the components?

Priya (A11y): will do — copy below for devs: `aria-label=\"Retention period in months\"`, `aria-describedby=\"retention-help\"` for the helper, `role=\"button\"` and `aria-expanded` toggles for disclosure of key details. Also ensure focus ring visible on keyboard nav and color contrast 4.5:1 for the badges.

Jamal (Frontend): perfect — I'll update the i18n keys: `retention.label`, `retention.helper`, `region.display_name`, `kms.label`, `audit.link`. I'll PR the component changes and include the aria attrs. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Maris (Product Design): sweet — I'll update the mock and add the tooltip copy. tagging @design-review for follow-up. :thumbsup:
